target.description: Target size (mandatory), e.g., '700m', '4.7g'. Unit suffixes: k, m, g, t.

bins.description: Maximum number of bins (volumes). Use 'unlimited' or a positive integer.

si.description: Use powers of 1000 (not 1024) for target, min, max, and output sizes.

min_size.description: Minimum file size. Use unit suffixes: k, m, g, t.

max_size.description: Maximum file size. Use unit suffixes: k, m, g, t.

block_size.description: Smallest amount of bytes a file can occupy (must be ≥1).

show_size.description: Print the size of each file.

hide_summary.description: Hide summary line containing sum, difference, and number of selected files.

sort_by_size.description: Sort the output by size, not by name.

sort_reverse.description: Sort the output in reverse order.

enclose_with.description: Enclose file names with this character.

delimit_with.description: Delimit file names (lines) with this character. Use '\n' for newline, '\0' for NUL.

null_data.description: Assume NULL (\0) as the delimiter of input files via stdin.

bins_separator.description: Separate bins (vols) with this character. Use '\n' for newline, '\0' for NUL.

ga_num_generations.description: Maximum number of generations (must be >0). 0 means auto.

ga_pop_size.description: Number of individuals (must be > tournament_size). 0 means auto.

ga_mutation_prob.description: Mutation probability per gene (0.0 <= value <= 1.0). 0.0 means auto.

ga_theoretical.description: Stop if theoretical minimum number of bins is reached. If non-zero, assumes this number.

approximate.description: Use Best First search (approximate, non-optimal but fast).

split.description: Just split the input when target size is reached (preserves original order).

direct_input.description: Switch to direct input mode: read "size identifier" pairs instead of file names.

di_kb.description: Assume input sizes as kibi bytes (KiB). KB if --di-si.

di_mb.description: Assume input sizes as mebi bytes (MiB). MB if --di-si.

di_gb.description: Assume input sizes as gibi bytes (GiB). GB if --di-si.

di_tb.description: Assume input sizes as tebi bytes (TiB). TB if --di-si.

di_si.description: Use powers of 1000 (not 1024) for input sizes.
